annotations.title: Pause or enable Trade Desk ad groups

description: level adgroup: status active (starts spending, needs confirm:true after the user says yes) or paused. level campaign: paused switches off every enabled ad group in it; a campaign has no on/off switch of its own, so active is refused (enable its ad groups instead). Read back. Free.
name: set_trade_desk_status
title: Pause or enable Trade Desk ad groups
